items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Because there had Freddie and Jules running there at the time I was there.

ctx.x: Because there had Freddie and Jules running there at the time I was there. Two boxes. Yeah, both of them were boxes. They were both punchy. Yeah, and the biggest brother, the large man, I forget his name, John, I believe, John Lutton. And the old lady was living there, his mother. She used to be all the time sitting in the back. She sat by the door which led to the bar. Yeah, of course. She had a big comfortable chair there and her crutches. They used to sell nothing but beer. No hard.
Soft drinks. Beer and soft drinks, yeah. Yeah, but bring your own liquor in.
